item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies range from partly to mostly cloudy with low temperatures between forty-five and fifty-five degrees and only a slight chance of rain showers early in some areas. Tomorrow brings partly to mostly cloudy conditions and high temperatures from sixty-six to seventy-four degrees, with little to no precipitation expected. Rain showers return tomorrow night into Thursday, with lows from fifty-one to fifty-seven degrees and precipitation becoming likely by Thursday morning.
